title: Timer loop
summary: Begin Play sets a timer by event, and the event sets it again.
when_to_use: Use this when a look or a pulse should run on a timer instead of Tick.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is to start the timer inside the event without a cap, or to use Tick.

nodes.note: Begin Play runs once. Start the timer here, not on Tick.
Set Timer by Event names the custom event. The simulation fires it immediately, up to a small cap, so the loop is visible.
TimerTick is the event the timer calls. It is not Tick. It runs on the timer interval.
The work for one loop. A print stands in for spawning, a pulse, or a cooldown check.
Setting the timer again makes the loop. Clear it in End Play so it does not fire after the actor is gone.
